newsitem.title: UK: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil weaker.
newsitem.headline: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil weaker.

text.p: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil was weaker on Monday as crude oil futures fell back, traders said.
Fixed-price talk was scarce and buyers' and sellers' assessments of market levels differed considerably.
A 50,000 tonne cargo, loading early in March, was sold to a U.S. refiner on Friday. The price was not known although some felt it was close to $2.50 a barrel beneath April Brent futures.
The same refiner was heard seeking more product, and dealers said the arbitrage window remained open for large-sized ships.
